finalText:
I worked all nine open change requests. Every change is booked in the customer's original cabin, and each fee is its own ledger entry. I left Q-306 (R5206, a cancellation) alone because it isn't a flight change. I didn't re-read the reservations or ledgers afterward. Each change call and fee entry reported success when I made it.

The system date is 2026-07-28, so "yesterday" meant the 27 July requests. The plan's date of 2026-10-05 didn't match the system, so I used the system date.

| Request | New flight | Charged | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| Q-301 Ines (R5201) | DL542, 6 Aug | $0 | Covered by the Chicago waiver (PB-2026-14), which waives the fee and fare difference. |
| Q-302 Jonah (R5202) | AA664, 7 Aug | $75 fee + $35 fare difference | The Boston waiver (PB-2026-09) expired on 15 July, so normal rules apply. |
| Q-303 Kim (R5203) | AA664, 7 Aug | $150 fee + $25 fare difference | Same expired waiver. The basic economy fee is $150 under PB-2026-16, which overrides the $125 in the fare rules. Silver status isn't exempt. |
| Q-304 Lena (R5204) | UA90, 9 Aug | $35 fare difference | Covered by PB-2026-14, which waives the fee. It still collects the fare difference on basic economy. |
| Q-305 Max (R5205) | AA216, 8 Aug | $75 fee + $10 fare difference | He booked on 26 July, after the waiver's 24 July ticketing cutoff. |
| Q-307 Oscar (R5207) | AA218, 8 Aug | $0 | He is platinum, so the amended waiver (PB-2026-14A) extends his travel window to 5 Aug. His 5 Aug flight is covered, even though he offered to pay. |
| Q-308 Petra (R5208) | AA662, 5 Aug | $75 fee | Same-day change under PB-2026-12: flat fee, no fare difference. |
| Q-309 Quinn (R5209) | AA1406 on the ORD→BOS leg only | $0 | PB-2026-14 covers it and costs less than the same-day fee, so I applied it under the "cheapest bulletin" rule (PB-2026-17). The SFO→ORD leg is unchanged. |
| Q-310 Ravi (R5210) | AA216, 8 Aug | $75 fee + $30 fare difference | The reservation history shows his one free move under PB-2026-14 was already used on 26 July. |

No refunds were needed, so I didn't check payment instruments or refund policies. All nine requests are resolved, each with a note to the customer explaining the settlement.
